easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show baked loaves of bread lying on a rack or tray? A photo, an illustration, a schematic or a plain diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows a blank card stating an answer with no bread in it, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.ear_side: 1=towards the oven|2=towards the oven|3=evenly on both sides
reference.cut_run: 1=each cut starts before the one in front ends|2=each cut starts before the one in front ends

In this cut-out, which way do the cuts on this loaf open? Answer with one of: towards the left edge of the picture, towards the right edge of the picture, evenly on both sides, or none if the cuts cannot be made out.
